description: Northern European AC/DC power system model with a North Sea Wind Power Hub is a model or code deposit deposited in DTU Data by its authors Danilo Obradovic, Matas Dijokas (Technical University of Denmark). In many power systems, the increased penetration of inverter-based renewable generation will cause a decrease in kinetic energy storage, leading to higher frequency excursions after a power disturbance. This is the case of the future Nordic Power System (NPS). Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1373402 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
